text_description: Full-length runway look in an almost all-black palette built around stark tailoring over lingerie-like lace: the model wears an oversized black blazer with a long, straight body, sharp padded shoulders, notched lapels, an open front, and sleeves that extend to the wrist with a slightly long, enveloping fit. Beneath it is a sheer black lace high-neck top with a close turtleneck-style collar and transparent floral lace patterning across the chest and torso, revealing a black bra-like underlayer; fine sheer lace also appears at the wrists under the blazer sleeves. The lower half is a very short black lace bottom or shorts with a high waist, loose lingerie proportion, and scalloped lace hems at the upper thigh, leaving the legs bare. Styling continues with sheer black mid-calf socks that sit slightly slouched around the ankles and glossy black square-toe heeled shoes or ankle boots. A small structured glossy black handbag is carried low in one hand, adding a polished accessory against the soft lace. The beauty styling is severe and refined, with slick side-parted hair and a dark red lip, reinforcing a nocturnal, tailored-underwear mood that contrasts masculine blazer volume with delicate transparent lace.
key_elements: oversized black tailored blazer with sharp shoulders
very short black lace shorts with scalloped hem
bare legs with sheer black mid-calf socks
slick side-parted hair and dark red lip
uncertainty_notes: Footwear appears to be heeled ankle boots or shoe-boots; exact construction is partially obscured by socks.
Bag and footwear appear glossy, possibly leather, but material is not confirmed from the image.
Blazer closure details are not visible because it is worn open.
